dimensions.name: Relationship recovery under a prescribed specification
Relationship discovery from data alone
dimensions.justification: Per-term importances and automatic pairwise interaction detection, no false-discovery control. Planted tasks: TPR 1.0 (interactions 10/10), FDR 0.310, silent on 5/5 null tasks.

dimensions.name: Experimental iteration speed
dimensions.justification: Session median 67.5 s, p90 90.3 s per follow-up; real battery median 50.5 s and p90 220 s. Half point: just over a minute per fit.

dimensions.name: Robustness across conditions
dimensions.justification: Completes 260/285 real runs; all 25 failures are 900 s timeouts on wide tables. Native missing and categorical handling; small-n median 10.7% below the reference.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty (calibration)
dimensions.justification: No prediction interval is offered for regression. Binary probabilities are well calibrated (median ECE 0.022, the lowest).

dimensions.name: Reproducibility and auditability
dimensions.justification: Identical on rerun 10/10; no decision trail.

dimensions.name: Predictive validity
dimensions.justification: Binary: within 5% of best on 33/47, median gap 1.9% (the best binary arm). Regression: within 5% on 18/39, median gap 7.8%. Half point: competitive on classification, not on regression; 9% of runs time out.
